name: Zen Heart Sutra VR
summary:
Zen Heart Sutra VR brings the ancient Heart Sutra (Hannya Shingyo) to life in
  an immersive virtual reality experience. Sit in a traditional Japanese zen
  room, surrounded by tatami floors, shoji screens, and seasonal garden views.

  # Features

  - **Full Heart Sutra** in brush calligraphy with furigana, modern Japanese
  translation, Romaji, and English translation
  - **Interactive instruments** — mokugyo (wooden fish drum) and orin (singing
  bowl) with realistic 3D spatial audio
